gen-gf-baloo-bhaijaan-2-satoshi: Satoshi reads soft and friendly, its tall lowercase and wide e cut from strokes of one width. Satoshi would carry a long page without tiring, while Baloo Bhaijaan 2 stands above it with rounded, cord-like weight.
gen-gf-baloo-bhaijaan-2-switzer: Switzer has a Swiss, wire-like look, its tubular letters standing tall with c tips that stay well apart, under the rounded Baloo Bhaijaan 2. Heavy display shapes up top, rod-straight lines below.
gen-gf-baloo-bhaijaan-2-work-sans: Modern and a little cheeky, Baloo Bhaijaan 2 heads the pair with open curves and a tall central band. Work Sans follows in a sans with joins that never pinch and a high mean line.
gen-gf-baloo-bhaina-2-archivo: Baloo Bhaina 2 brings wide-set s terminals and a high x-height to the top line. Archivo, a plain sans with curves that open outward, would look puny if the heading were made small.
gen-gf-baloo-bhaina-2-fs-asap: Chunky, friendly shapes lead here, with Baloo Bhaina 2 spreading its s terminals wide. And Asap handles the quieter work, a sans-serif whose open c arcs and capital-height lowercase keep text moving.
gen-gf-baloo-bhaina-2-fs-be-vietnam-pro: Baloo Bhaina 2 is the loud one, with wide-set s terminals and a high-set x-height. Be Vietnam Pro is the quiet one, a plain sans of flat, bent-steel linework with a high mean line.
gen-gf-baloo-bhaina-2-fs-epilogue: Bold, bouncy, and a bit cheeky, Baloo Bhaina 2 sets the tone with wide s terminals. But Epilogue is the real hook: a sans with wire-like monoline strokes and no hairlines to squint at.
gen-gf-baloo-bhaina-2-fs-fira-sans: Big, bold, and confident, Baloo Bhaina 2 stretches its s terminals wide up top. Fira Sans, a sans with a generous x-height and no stroke contrast, would carry a long page smoothly.
gen-gf-baloo-bhaina-2-fs-merriweather-sa: Distinctive from its first line, Baloo Bhaina 2 sits high on the x-height with wide s terminals. Merriweather Sans, a plain sans with sturdy tall lowercase and a clearly open e, would make long reading feel steady.
gen-gf-baloo-bhaina-2-fs-public-sans: Bold in attitude, Baloo Bhaina 2 sets wide s terminals against a high x-height. Public Sans sits next to it feeling sturdy and trustworthy, a sans with hefty lowercase and broad open counters.
